title: Holtburger Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugin manifests under apps/holtburger-web/plugins/. Adapted from Chorizite's PluginManifest (external/chorizite/Chorizite/Chorizite.Core/Plugins/PluginManifest.cs:13-148) for the browser/JS world. Departures (per Chorizite READING_GUIDE §4.1): `entry` instead of `entryFile`; `environments` uses browser/tui/cli rather than Client/Launcher/Inspector; `dependencies` accepts npm-style semver ranges plus Chorizite's `?` optional suffix; `slots` + `hotkeys` are new declarative fields.

$schema.description: Optional JSON-Schema-self-reference; ignored by loader. Permits IDE validation.

id.description: Unique plugin id across all plugins. Mirrors PluginManifest.Id (PluginManifest.cs:23). Reverse-DNS or kebab-case both accepted.

version.description: Semver-shape version string (e.g. `1.2.3` or `0.1.0-rc.1`). Mirrors PluginManifest.Version (PluginManifest.cs:38) — Chorizite validates with `new Version(Version)`, which is `MAJOR.MINOR[.BUILD[.REVISION]]`. The loader's `parseSemver` accepts npm-style semver plus the C# `System.Version` shape for round-trip compatibility.

icon.description: Either a path to an icon file (relative to the manifest), a remote URL, or a single literal glyph (`⚔`, `📖`, etc) used by the bar. Mirrors PluginManifest.Icon (PluginManifest.cs:53). The existing bar slot pattern uses 1-2 character glyphs because the bar renders them via CSS text content, not .

iconHidden.description: Holtburger-specific extension (not in Chorizite). When true, the plugin still runs its `mount` lifecycle but claims no bar real-estate. Used by always-on overlays like vitals-hud/buffs-hud/radar/chat-panel.

dependencies.description: Per-plugin dependency list. Format: `"<id>@<version>"` or `"<id>@<version>?"` (trailing `?` = optional, resolver continues if missing). Mirrors Chorizite's PluginManager.StartPlugin (PluginManager.cs:191-220). Versions accept npm-style semver ranges (`^1.0.0`, `~1.2`, `1.2.3`, `*`).

environments.description: Environments in which this plugin runs. Holtburger uses browser/tui/cli (vs. Chorizite's Client/Launcher/Inspector/DocGen per porting-plan §9 item 7). Empty array = all environments.

entry.description: Relative module path to the plugin's ESM entry. Loader dispatches by extension (`.js` / `.mjs` = ESM; future `.wasm` reserved). Holtburger uses `entry` instead of Chorizite's `entryFile` per READING_GUIDE §4.1 departures table — this is the same field, renamed.

slots.description: Declares which UI slots this plugin contributes to (e.g. `bar`, `hud`, `panel`). Lets the loader pre-allocate DOM without instantiating the plugin. NEW vs Chorizite — Chorizite plugins are not slot-typed.

clientApi.description: P6.1 (2026-07-27): semver range of the plugin-facing client facade API this plugin targets (compared against client.apiVersion / plugins/api.js API_VERSION). Absent = no constraint. Loader enforcement lands with migration step 6 of the P6.1 design doc; until then this is declarative.

capabilities.description: P6.1 (2026-07-27): capability names this plugin requires (CAPABILITY_CANDIDATES keys / client.capabilities entries). Trailing `?` marks a capability optional, same convention as dependencies. A required capability missing from client.capabilities skips the plugin with a logged reason — the observable version of retail IAsheronsCall's silent E_FAIL stubs. Also the data source for answering the retail plugin-manifest wire query (S->C GameEvent 0x02AE Admin_QueryPluginList -> C->S GameAction 0x02AF {context:u32, pluginList:string}).

hotkeys.description: Declares default key bindings up-front so the settings UI can show them without instantiating the plugin. NEW vs Chorizite.

label.description: Human-readable label for the settings UI.
